user_task: 查阅可检索的本地技术文档，确定 AsterDB 4.2 的三个默认配置：快照保留天数、检查点间隔分钟数、最大并行导入数。交付内容是这些配置的答案；请仅返回 JSON 对象，字段为 "retention_days"、"checkpoint_minutes"、"max_parallel_imports"，字段值均为整数。可额外包含 source_ids 数组用于列出证据来源。
query: AsterDB 4.2 defaults retention checkpoint parallel imports

documents.title: AsterDB 4.2: official snapshot retention reference
documents.text:
# AsterDB 4.2 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 4.2, snapshot retention is 35 calendar days (retention_days=35).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

documents.title: AsterDB: archived legacy defaults, NOT release 4.2
documents.text:
# Archived AsterDB legacy profile

This archive does NOT describe AsterDB 4.2. It documents an obsolete pre-release profile only.
Historical snapshot retention: 7 days. Historical checkpoint interval: 60 minutes. Historical maximum parallel imports: 1.
Current defaults must be obtained from documents for the exact release.

documents.title: AsterDB: storage and import terminology
documents.text:
# AsterDB glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.

category.bug: The text reports that an existing behavior is malfunctioning.

priority.high: The impact field is exactly one of: production outage; data loss; credential exposure.
priority.normal: Every other impact field, even if the description uses words such as urgent.

rules.independence: Classify category and priority independently; do not infer extra impact.
